description: Call this when the free daily checks are used up and a person wants a link to buy a prepaid credit pack. Free to call; never charges. Returns a personal link where a person can buy a prepaid credit pack by card ($10 for 1,000 checks or $25 for 2,500 checks, credits expire 12 months after purchase) for the API key sent with this call, plus the credits left on that key. Use it when the free daily checks are used up.
name: start_upgrade
title: Get an upgrade link
